description: ROM Ali Water Dive, Air Combat, Splash & Shoreline Exit

routines.name: ali_water_paddle_coast
routines.purpose: Advance stroke counter $FF1980 and transition to anim 0x24 / state 0x10 on anim end

routines.name: ali_water_dive_jump_arc
routines.purpose: Airborne gravity arc (subi.l #0xC000) for water dive jumps and landing recovery

routines.name: ali_air_attack_dispatch_from_water
routines.purpose: In-air weapon dispatch on Button A (sword anim 0x32, dagger anim 0x50/0x62)

routines.name: ali_water_splash_landing
routines.purpose: Water surface landing reset, height clear, and splash SFX 0x600343

routines.name: ali_shoreline_boundary_exit_triggers
routines.purpose: Shoreline climb-out jump impulse (0x40000/0x50000), splash SFX 0x500341, anims 0x72/0x74/0x76
